title: Concept: Server-side fetch of assembled URL (java) — review required
description: In java, news+URLs*([^)]*+ makes the server issue a request to a computed URL. SSRF weaponizes the server's network position: cloud metadata, internal admin ports, and intranet hosts. The remedy is host allowlisting via a host allowlist.
applicability: java server code fetching URLs; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Internal network access and credential theft via metadata endpoints; HIGH severity.
